# Lodged in Vancouver, stamped in Washington

From: Pat Morales, office manager, Inlet Medical
To: Jordan Hale, records, Cascade Seattle
Date: 18 March 2027
Subject: PERMIT-12, two dates on one application

Jordan,

I am writing because the member's copy and our copy do not tell the same story, and the member has started quoting the later date at the desk.

The application was lodged at the Vancouver desk on 1 March 2027, late afternoon Pacific. The desk receipt shows the Vancouver postal code V6B 1A1. Noel Park has that slip. The member still has the phone photo of it.

Your office stamped the same application on 20 March. That stamp is a Cascade records stamp, Washington. The member has not seen that stamp. I have, because Sam Nguyen forwarded the nightly extract and the stamp was sitting on the image. Sam is not the records office. Sam was only the person who noticed a date that was not the lodge date.

The member asked me, on the phone, "how many days since I lodged this." I do not answer that question from a stamp I have not shown them. Dana Okonkwo's office has a board that already shows a number of days for this application. I asked Morgan Ibarra which date that number starts from. Morgan said the board is a counter and the counter is what we publish. That is not an answer to the member.

I am not asking you to withdraw the Washington stamp. I am asking you to say, in writing, whether the stamp is the day the application was lodged or the day Cascade touched it. Those are different days. Nineteen days is one story. A shorter count is another. I will not pick one in this letter.

The member is in British Columbia. The stamp is in Washington. If your office needs the Vancouver slip, ask Noel. Please do not tell the member the Washington date is the lodge date unless that is what your stamp actually is. I do not think it is. I also do not think I am the records office.

Pat Morales
Inlet Medical, now filing under Cedar Ridge
---

From: Jordan Hale
To: Pat Morales
Date: 19 March 2027

Pat,

The stamp is the day the image hit Cascade records. I am not saying that is the day the member lodged it. I am saying it is the day our counter moved. Dana's board uses that counter. I did not build the board. If the member is counting from the Vancouver slip, they are counting a different event. I will not change the stamp to match the slip. Send me the slip if you want it in the image packet. It will be a second page, not a replacement.

Jordan
